name: Hino Kayoko
source:
A stubborn girl, part of the class council.
She is usually called "chairman".
While she is more responsible than most. she does have a strong tendency to self-preservation.
She likes manipulating Hazuki into doing what she doesn't want to.

[From in-game charater profile]

A member of class 503.
